name: Brute Bonnet
description: Brute Bonnet, the Paradox Pokémon. A Grass and Dark type.
pokedex_entries: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.
It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.
